_comment: ECS Fargate task definition TEMPLATE for @stimuliiq/api — the documented
scale-out target once Railway (the MVP default, CLAUDE.md §1, railway.json at
the repo root) is outgrown. NOT wired into any CI job yet (Phase-7 Wave 4,
devops CI hardening) — this is committed scaffolding for the eventual ECS
migration, not an active deploy path. Every <PLACEHOLDER> below is a real value
a human must supply at activation time (AWS account id, ECR repo, ARNs, secret
ARNs in Secrets Manager/SSM Parameter Store). NEVER put a real secret value
directly in this file — 'secrets' entries reference an ARN; ECS resolves the
actual value at task launch, it is never written here or logged.
Build + push the image with:
docker build -f infra/docker/api.Dockerfile -t <ECR_REPO_URI>:<TAG> .
docker push <ECR_REPO_URI>:<TAG>
Register with:
aws ecs register-task-definition --cli-input-json file://infra/ecs/task-definition.json
Every 'secrets' entry below is an ARN reference (AWS Secrets Manager or SSM
Parameter Store) — see .env.example for what each var does and how to obtain
the underlying value. ECS resolves these at task launch; the real value is
never written in this file or logged. Strip every '_comment' key (this one
included) before registering — they are documentation only, not valid ECS
task-definition fields.

healthCheck._comment: Matches the API's readiness endpoint (DB + Redis ping, AC-42, docs/specs/phase-7-analytics-hardening.md) — NOT the plain liveness endpoint, so ECS only routes traffic to a task whose dependencies are actually reachable.
